extras.notes: nose faces -Y; stands on its tricycle landing gear (z = 0 = tire bottoms); 3 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); two rear-mounted turbofans, T-tail, winglets; opaque tinted windows, no interior; neutral paint, no logo, no text, no registration

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
